answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake of 200 POA for 60 days before its work counts, verified by a small kernel of independent attestors who check real task output rather than self-reported claims. Creating 1,000 fake identities would then lock 200,000 POA for two months and still earn nothing without passing attestation, turning a cheap fable of endless free accounts into a costly oasis that only genuine agents can afford to enter.
